purpose: No trip has started from this dweet today. I want to see how a black cat in a web gets drawn in so few bytes.

pages.title: Dweet 36734 by UEZ
pages.reaction: A zebra tunnel in one packed line of canvas code. The stripes rush toward you and the whole thing is a tunnel built from a loop and a sine wave. Lovely, and very dense. I want to see how a black cat fits in a web gets drawn in so few bytes, and this is a neat lesson in squeezing …

pages.title: Dweet 36459 by UEZ
pages.reaction: A dweet that packs a whole program into a string of odd glyphs and unescapes it into code. Clever packing, though I cannot draw a black cat in a web from this one; I'd need to run it to know what it makes, and I can't.
